purpose: Static incremental malicious-behavior and dependency provenance review only

scope.build: Unchanged central golang:1.26-alpine; go mod download; CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build ./cmd/server; CI binary --help
scope.runtime: Unchanged alpine:3.22.0; tzdata and ca-certificates; /app/CLIProxyAPIPlus and config.example.yaml; port 8317; configured provider/Home/plugin/management behavior
scope.method: Every changed file full unified diff read, including all added files and all tests. Identical portions reuse approved baseline; necessary sensitive context separately read. No upstream clone/install/build/test/scan/execution during review.

diff_read.method: All unified diff lines, indentation elided; unchanged source reused from approved baseline; shared context separate

dependencies.basis: Complete immutable trees show no dependency manifest, checksum, source override, vendor or installation/build configuration changes. Existing dependency provenance and sensitive implementations reuse approved v8.0.40 baseline; new imports use existing module versions or Go standard library.

basis.assessment: 协议连接回收、RESP 读取边界及模型元数据；未增加命令执行、鉴权旁路或外传目标。
新 RTT 上报只沿现有 Home command pool，字段为 process_id、节点 IP/port、sequence、观测时间/age、RTT 和有效性；探测只接受既有 clusterNodes 中非当前节点，复用配置 TLS，warmup 和实测各一次 PING，3 秒超时、每报告周期最多一个探测且失败退避。无新增第三方接收站点、隐蔽下载或凭据导出。
模型目录 token limit 字段回退与相应测试，只有内存数据格式化。
Gemini/Vertex promptFeedback 与流终止错误沿既有响应/用量路径返回；插件用量合并为数字统计，没有新增输入来源或输出接收方。
Gemini thoughtSignature sentinel 的并行工具组边界变化；只改 provider 历史载荷，不涉及服务鉴权或执行工具。
Antigravity/Gemini 工具参数拼接、结束状态与用量转换；Codex commentary 分块映射为 thinking。JSON/SSE 数据转换没有新增网络、进程或文件操作。
本地 JSON Pointer 引用合并、allOf 约束及参数占位清理；新增 reflect.DeepEqual 只比较数据。无远程引用下载或动态代码执行。
插件用量集成测试仅调整输入样例及统计检查。
新增本地转换测试使用内存 JSON；没有外部数据发送或脚本执行。

limits: 通过 means no malicious behavior evidence found in the stated static increment, not vulnerability/correctness/quality certification.
Unchanged baseline source and dependency toolchains are reused, not freshly reviewed. Upstream development workflows and unexecuted tooling are not recursively recertified.

Central CI may build only after this approval and is not source-review evidence. Existing workflow sets provenance:false; publication checks CI checkout/build chain and OCI revision/source labels, not cryptographic build attestations.
No deployment or service restart is authorized or performed.
